Only live skills appear here: a skill that kept its name (implement, scope-guard, hasura, docs) needs no entry, and legacy_name never carries a move between plugins (record.mjs reports skill_plugin separately, so those series split deliberately: discovery-interview raftkit-core -> raftkit-docs in v2, folded into docs-product in v3; hasura raftkit-dev -> raftkit-hasura in v3). v3 renames for the dashboard notes: suite + run-sheet -> test-cases (continues test-suite; test-run-sheet ends); meeting -> profile (call mode; meeting-decisions ends); story size -> estimate (one story); routine deleted (deprecation-sweep ends; its prompt is a hand-run asset).
